signal: Exiger was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Supplier Risk Management for the second year running and acquired aDolus to extend its software supply chain platform.

email.body1:
Seth, saw Exiger landed Leader in the 2026 Gartner MQ again and folded aDolus into the platform.

That kind of expansion usually outpaces the team's ability to act on every in-market account fast, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR turns buying signals into booked meetings with zero rep time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for Exiger off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Seth, quick follow-up for Exiger.

Most RevOps teams know the signals exist but can't move them to action fast enough, so good-fit accounts go cold before a rep ever reaches them. Tightening that loop is usually the cheapest pipeline lift available.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Seth, last bit of proof for Exiger.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

Want to grab time so I can walk you through how Exiger's reply rate compares to other B2B software companies? I pulled a quick benchmark.
email.body4:
Seth, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-recognition stretches keep RevOps buried in scaling the engine that's already running.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I'll tailor it to Exiger either way.
